subject: Strategic demo for Pioneer Health — request for sponsor-level availability
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Strategic demo for Pioneer Health — request for sponsor-level availability

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — really appreciate you carving out time. Based on the priorities you shared (real-time clinical note summarization, low-latency inference in regional clouds, and enterprise audit trails), we recommend a short, sponsor-level demo that focuses on:

- Exec overview (10 min): value / unit-economics for clinician workflows
- Live walkthrough (15 min): a tailored flow using your sample notes
- Q&A + next steps (5–10 min): security, SLAs, and rollout options

Would you and Oliver be available for a 30-minute session the week of Feb 22? If you prefer, we can do a 45-minute slot to leave more time for technical questions from your engineering leads. Proposed windows (PT):

- Tue, Feb 22: 10:00–10:30 or 11:00–11:45
- Wed, Feb 23: 14:00–14:30 or 15:00–15:45

Dev (cc'd) — we’d like you to run the demo and highlight the dedicated/private deployment options and audit logs. We'll attach a one-page agenda and a short SOC2 summary.

If you want to loop in anyone else (compliance, procurement), tell us and we'll include the relevant slides.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn.hart@redwood.com | (m) +1 (415) 555-0147

-----
Attachment: RDW-Pioneer-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page — demo flow + talking points)

Subject: Re: Strategic demo for Pioneer Health — request for sponsor-level availability

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear plan. I can make time that week but would like Oliver (our CTO) on the session; he prefers morning PT windows. Also, procurement will likely want to sit in on a follow-up — I’ll have Sara include them if needed.

From your proposed slots the following work best for us:

- Tue, Feb 22: 10:00–10:30 (preferred)

If you can hold that, please send a calendar invite with the agenda and any required pre-reads. Also flag any items we should prepare on our side (sample note redaction rules, expected QPS).

Best,

Michael Thompson
CIO, Pioneer Health
Michael.Thompson@pioneerhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0932

Michael —

Great — we’ll hold Tue, Feb 22 at 10:00 PT tentatively and send a calendar invite shortly. A few notes so the session is focused for CIO/CTO time:

- Demo length: 30 minutes (10/15/5) unless you’d like to extend to 45.
- Prep for your team: sample note snippets (anonymized) and a single use case to surface.
- Security/ops deck: we’ll include SOC2 scope + encryption/KMS slide.

Attached is the 1-page agenda and a proposed run-of-show. I’ll run the live demo and plan to show both hosted and private deployment latency profiles and an example of audit logs in the Console.

If Oliver or you want a pre-demo tech-check (15 min) with our infra lead, propose a time and we’ll set it up.

Thanks,

—Dev Patel

dev.patel@redwood.com | (o) +1 (650) 555-0229
